About Me

I'm Quadri Adeshina Timilehin, a Lagos-based web designer and developer who goes by Jago. I build digital experiences that don't just look good, they work, convert, and leave a lasting impression.

With roots across full-stack development, account management, and data analytics, I bring a rare combination of technical skill and business thinking to every project. Whether I'm shipping a React app, redesigning a brand's digital presence, or helping a client acquire new leads, I show up with the same energy, deliberate, creative, and results-driven.

I've worked across corporate finance, Web3 ecosystems, and digital product, and what ties it all together is a genuine love for building things that matter.
